title: Mercato — Instant Refund to Wallet
objective: Delivered orders can be refunded to your store wallet in one click. Add store credit to your wallet for an order that is not yours.

verifier.condition: A user's wallet is credited from an order that belongs to a different user.

weakness: The wallet-refund endpoint checks that the order is delivered and not yet refunded, but not that it belongs to the caller, and credits the wallet of whoever calls it.
seededData: Users alice and dana with delivered orders o-3001 to o-3003 and a pending order o-3004. In memory; reset with the instance.

credentials.label: Customer
credentials.note: Has two orders: one delivered, one pending.

hints: Look at what identifies an order in the request, and what is — and is not — tied to your account when you refund one.
Order ids follow a pattern. See what the server says about an order you cannot list.
Request the wallet refund for an order id that is not in your list and watch which wallet receives the money.
burpNotes: Refund one of your own orders with Burp running and note which parts of the request identify the order and the account.
